$comment: Type-check only — nothing is emitted. Node runs the .ts files directly via
--experimental-strip-types, which erases types without transforming code. That
means no enums, no namespaces, no parameter properties, no decorators, and .ts
extensions on every relative import. verbatimModuleSyntax enforces the last part.
This config is intentionally standalone: the harness must not inherit the app's
Vue/DOM setup, and nothing here should end up in the app build.
